API ReferenceZIdentity APIUsersUsers Ops Update Password
Users Ops Update Password
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/users/:id:updatepassword

Updates the password for a specific user ID. Optionally, a boolean flag can be set to require the user to reset their password during next login.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

The user ID of the individual for whom the password needs to be updated.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
resetPwdOnLogin
boolean

A flag indicating whether the user should be prompted to reset their password on the next login.

password
string
REQUIRED

The new password to be set for the user.

Responses
​
200
400

The request was successful, and the password has been reset.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
string
string
